Shadowed today rather than load-bearing: Relic.is_tradable (relics/base.py:126-136) already returns False for Ancient rarity, so the flag changes nothing for this relic -- the same 'already excluded by rarity' situation audit/records/relic/byrdpip.json records for its two DROPPED declarations. Correct to declare it anyway, since rarity and the flag are independent in the source. Rule 7: relics/base.py are not hashed by this record.

AfterObtained.rationale: LoomingFruit.cs:45-48 is a single `CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp(Owner.Creature, MaxHpVar(31).BaseValue)`; looming_fruit.py:19 is `run.gain_max_hp(self.MAX_HP)`. RunState.gain_max_hp (run.py:311-314) raises max HP and then heals the same amount, mirroring GainMaxHp's SetMaxHp-then-Heal(delta). EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-maxhp): from 80/80 the relic gives 111/111, and from 40/80 it gives 71/111 -- i.e. +31 max HP and +31 current HP, C#'s numbers in both cases. Note this relic does NOT heal to full (contrast relic/lees_waffle, whose C# adds a second Heal call), and the port correctly stops at one statement. Rule 7: run.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.rationale: No AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension anywhere in LoomingFruit.cs, so 31 is the pinned non-ascension value and BaseValue is the read the shared contract pins.

guards.what: N2: `IconBaseName` and the 50% `HasCornucopia()` roll off SaveManager.Instance.Progress.UniqueId (LoomingFruit.cs:14-43)
guards.rationale: The source's own doc comment says '50% chance of Looming Fruit having the cornucopia ... Players will only know if there's a cornucopia or not by seeing OTHER player's Looming Fruit' -- it selects between two ICON textures (`base.IconBaseName + "_2"`) and nothing else; no gameplay member reads it. It is also profile-scoped (the last character of the save's UniqueId), not run-scoped, so it is not even a per-run RNG draw the parity harness could see. Waived under the presentation exclusion. Recorded explicitly because a reader who saw only `HasCornucopia()` might take it for a hidden 50% gameplay effect and file a phantom gap. RelicModel.Flash() / FlashSfx / base.Status = RelicStatus.* / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / InvokeDisplayAmountChanged / UpdateDisplay / IsActivating / DoActivateVisuals / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / IconBaseName / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview / TaskHelper.RunSafely of a visuals task are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter, sfx, icon variant and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N3: undo_after_obtained (looming_fruit.py:21-25) restores the max HP but not the healed current HP
guards.issue: SEPARATE, SIM-ONLY DEFECT worth recording here because this relic is one of only five that implement it: `undo_after_obtained` (relics/base.py:143-150) exists purely for the conformance runner, which grants a node's relic and then swaps it for the one the save says was really picked (sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:461, 694), and its stated purpose is that 'a discarded max-HP relic (Mango, Pear, ...) leaves its +MaxHp behind and the player-state parity check reads high for the rest of the run'. The implementation gives back the MAX HP but not the CURRENT HP the grant healed: EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-maxhp) a player at 40/80 who takes Looming Fruit reaches 71/111, and undo_after_obtained then leaves 71/80 -- THIRTY-ONE current HP that the un-granted relic paid for. (From 80/80 the undo is exact, because the heal was capped away.) relic/lees_waffle in this same batch has the same defect with a larger magnitude. There is no C# counterpart to diverge from -- nothing in the game un-picks a relic -- so this is filed as a note on the sim's own machinery rather than a source-to-sim verdict, but it defeats exactly the DETECTOR 3 act-boundary HP assertion the helper was written for. Rule 7: relics/base.py and sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N4: no state, no reset, no IsAllowed, no combat hooks
guards.rationale: LoomingFruit.cs declares five members: Rarity, IconBaseName, HasUponPickupEffect, CanonicalVars and AfterObtained. PROMPT.md bug class 13 cannot apply -- the relic holds nothing (the shared `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset` puts it in the 200-relic 'holds no state' bucket) -- and bug class 16's first half does not either: no IsAllowed override, confirmed by the full-brace rescan `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-isallowed`, which enumerates all 20 overrides and does not list this relic.

guards.what: N5: obtainability -- the relic is Ancient rarity AND appears in the transcribed grab bag
guards.rationale: EXECUTED (b08-pool): `bag=Ancient` and it is additionally granted by the ported Nonupeipe shrine (events/nonupeipe.py). Recorded because Ancient relics are normally NOT bag members (relics/base.py's _MERCHANT_COST_BY_RARITY treats Ancient as unbuyable and Relic.is_tradable excludes it), so a reader checking obtainability could wrongly conclude the relic is event-only and mis-scope a reachability argument built on it. Rule 7: relics/base.py and events/nonupeipe.py are not hashed by this record.
